```{r}
library(disdat)
library(mgcv)
library(sf)
library(spatstat)
library(fields)
library(tmap)
library(grid)
library(units)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
library(scampr)
#install.packages("glmmTMB_1.1.9-9000.tar.gz",  repos = NULL, type = "source")
library(glmmTMB)
set.seed(0)

# Get the data
source("get_and_format_flora_data.R")
rm(dat_pa)

# Optional predictor subsets
# preds <- switch(pred_set,
#                 A = "None",
#                 B = c("mi", "tempann"),
#                 C = c("mi", "tempann", "mi2", "tempann2"),
# )

# Get a vector of the factor terms
facts <- c("disturb", "soilfert", "vegsis")

# Load the species information
load("flora_species.RDATA")

# Retain selected flora groups
flora_groups <- unique(sp.info$group)
pres <- pres[pres$group %in% flora_groups, ]

# Keep species with at least 10 presences
pres <- pres[pres$spid %in% names(table(pres$spid))[table(pres$spid) >= 10], ]

# Retained species
species <- unique(pres$spid)

# Dimensions
m <- length(species) # responses
q <- nrow(quad) # quadrature points

# Replicate quadrature points for each species
tmp <- quad[rep(seq_len(q), m), ]
tmp$spid <- rep(species, each = q) # assign the species id's

dat <- rbind(pres, tmp)
n <- nrow(dat)
rm(tmp)

# Preserve lon/lat and use model coordinates as x/y
dat$lon <- dat$x; dat$lat <- dat$y; dat$x <- dat$xm; dat$y <- dat$ym; dat$xm <- NULL; dat$ym <- NULL

load("domain.RDATA")
domain$lon <- domain$x; domain$lat <- domain$y; domain$x <- domain$xm; domain$y <- domain$ym; domain$xm <- NULL; domain$ym <- NULL

gc()
```


```{r}
# Preserve lon/lat and use model coordinates as x/y
rm.env <- function(m) {
  attr(attr(m$frame, "terms"), ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$terms$cond$fixed, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$reTrms$cond$terms$fixed, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$combForm, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$formula, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$ziformula, ".Environment") <- NULL
  attr(m$modelInfo$allForm$dispformula, ".Environment") <- NULL
  m
}
```


```{r Build spatial basis functions}
bfs <- make_basis(k = 50, domain, from.package = "scampr")

# Pruning basis functions with zero support
if (is(bfs, "scampr.bf")) {
  tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, rbind(pres[,c("xm", "ym")], quad[,c("xm", "ym")])) # via the data?
  # tmp <- bf_matrix(bfs, pres[,c("xm", "ym")]) # via the data?
  bf.check <- apply(tmp, 2, function(x){sum(x > 0)})
  bfs <- bfs[bf.check != 0, ]
  rm(tmp, bf.check)
}

# Evaluate basis functions at data locations
Z_star = bf_matrix(bfs, dat[, c("x", "y")])
#Z_star = Z_star/max(apply(Z_star,2,sd)) #some standardisation needed for ridge fits
save(Z_star, file = "Z_star.RDATA")
load("Z_star.RDATA")

```


```{r Fitting - alternating column/row updates (single latent spatial factor)}

ridgePen=1 #penalty strength

### standardise X's up here to variance of one ###

# Initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

# Convert species IDs to numeric
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))

attach(dat_rename)

# Shared spatial field
Zu = Z_star%*%u

chosen_spid = unique(spid)
n_species = length(chosen_spid)

# Fixed-effect design matrix
X_full = cbind(1, mi, tempann)

# Store species-specific intercepts, slopes and loadings
beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = n_species, ncol = ncol(Zu) + ncol(X_full)) 
# Store factor
new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(Z_star), ncol = 1) #k x 1

# Row indices for each species
rows_by_species = split(seq_len(nrow(dat_rename)), spid)

# Species index for each row
species_idx_row = match(spid, chosen_spid)

# Outer (column-update + row-update) iterations
N = 100
loglik = -Inf

# Species-specific warm starts
warm_start = vector("list", n_species)

# Factor warm starts
warm_start_u = vector("list", nrow(as.matrix(u))) #cases exist where algorithm diverges or takes too long

# Penalise only the spatial loading
#penalty_factor = c(rep(0, ncol(X_full) - 1), rep(1, ncol(Zu))) #cases exist where algorithm diverges

time_i = system.time({for (iter in 1:N){

  # Covariates and current spatial field
  X_Zu = cbind(X_full[, -1], Zu)

  # Species update: for each species, fit fixed effects + basis-function loadings (lambda)
  
  for (j in seq_along(chosen_spid)){
    i = chosen_spid[j]
    idx = rows_by_species[[as.character(i)]]
    
    # Species-specific design matrix
    X_i = X_Zu[idx, ]
    
    # Weighted Poisson ridge regression - DWPR response (pt/wt), weight = wt
    glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = occ[idx]/wt[idx], x = as.matrix(X_i), family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = wt[idx], intercept = TRUE, alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, warm = warm_start[[j]])#, penalty.factor = penalty_factor)#, maxit = nGlmnetIter)
    
    # Store this species' intercept + beta + lambda (1 loading)
    beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) 
    
    # Update warm start
    warm_start[[j]] = list(a0 = glmnet1$a0, beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
  }
  
  # Split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)]
  lambda = as.matrix(beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)])
  
  # Expand loadings to observation rows
  lambda_rep = lambda[species_idx_row, , drop = TRUE]

  # Fixed-effect linear predictor
  offset = rowSums(X_full * beta[species_idx_row, , drop = FALSE]) 
  
  # Shared-field design matrix
  X_joint = Z_star * lambda_rep
  attr(X_joint, "xm") = rep(0, ncol(X_joint))
  attr(X_joint, "xs") = rep(1, ncol(X_joint))
  
  # Ridge update for u
  for (i in 1:nrow(new_u)){
    glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(x = X_joint[, i, drop = FALSE], y = occ/wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = wt, offset = as.numeric(offset), alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, warm = warm_start_u[[i]]) 
    
    # Update shared-field coefficients
    new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
    
    # Update warm start
    warm_start_u[[i]] = list(a0 = 0, beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
   }

  u = new_u
  print(u)
  
  # Recompute shared spatial field with updated u, for next iteration's column update
  Zu = Z_star%*%u
  
  # Full linear predictor
  eta = offset + (Z_star * lambda_rep) %*% u
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_mglmnet_individ_row = mu

  # Weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row = sum(occ * log(mu) - wt * mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row, "\n")
  
  # Stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if (is.finite(loglik) && abs(loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row)) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row}
})
save(loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row, file = "loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row.RDATA")

time_mglmnet_individ_row = as.numeric(time_i[3])
time_mglmnet_individ_row
save(time_mglmnet_individ_row, file = "time_mglmnet_individ_row.RDATA")
```

```{r Intensity map}
m_intensity_map = function(grid_pred_lonlat, species_label = ""){
  map <- tm_shape(border_lonlat) +
    tm_borders() +
    tm_shape(grid_pred_lonlat) + # create tmap object for points to overlay
    tm_raster(col = "log_intensity",
                col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(
                  values = "turbo",

    tm_dots(size = 0.4, col = "black", shape = 4, col_alpha = 0.8) + #, fill.legend = tm_legend_hide()) + # add the points

    tm_grid(lwd = 0.2, labels.inside.frame = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, crs = 4326, # add the grid
            labels.format = list(big.mark = ",", fun = function(x){paste0(x, "º")})) # add degree symbol
}  
save(m_intensity_map, file = "m_intensity_map.RDATA")
```

```{r Inhomogeneous K functions}
#diagnostic for the chosen species, target_species_id

#Calculate observed, simulated K functions

#prediction grid, drop old "z" column, then re-attach this species' own z
domain.grid = subset(grid_xy, select = -z)
#predict intensity values for this species at every grid cell
domain.grid$z = grid_xy$z

#parameter values - this species' own 43 basis-function loading
lambda_j = lambda[species_idx, ]

#variance of the shared latent spatial field coefficients u (assumed common across all 43 basis functions)
var_u = 1/ridgePen

#per-basis-function variance of this species' realised spatial contribution (u_k * lambda_jk):
#Var(u_k * lambda_jk) = lambda_jk^2 * Var(u_k), lambda_jk fixed, known
vars <- rep(var_u, m.lgcp_lp$basis.per.res)

#propagate variance through basis functions at every grid location - Var(sum_k Z_k(loc) * u_k * lambda_jk) = sum_k Z_k(loc)^2 * Var(u_k * lambda_jk)
var_smooth_grid <- drop((Z_grid_star * lambda_j)^2 %*% vars)

#average propagated variance
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)
#var_smooth = var(drop(Z_grid_star%*%u)) #Z_grid_star

#this species' fixed-effect-only linear predictor - used as mean
domain.grid$mean = drop(X_grid%*%beta[species_idx, ])

#build observation window in same centred/rescaled km coordinate system used throughout
border_km = st_union(st_geometry(border_proj))/1000
st_crs(border_km) = NA
win = as.owin(st_sf(geometry = border_km))

#convert fixed-effect surface and full fitted intensity surface into spatstat pixel images
fixed.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x", "y", "mean")], W = win)
#converted predicted intensity value into spatstat pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain.grid[,c("x","y","z")], W = win)

#simulate the envelopes/bounds

#rename presence_df's spid to match dat_rename's convention, then subset to just this species' own presence locations
pres_df_rename = presence_df %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
sp_presence_df = pres_df_rename[pres_df_rename$spid == target_species_id, ]
# build species' point pattern within study window
po_sp_ppp = ppp(x = sp_presence_df$x,
                y = sp_presence_df$y,
                window = win)

#load("opt.RDATA")

#observed inhomogeneous K-function for this species, using its fitted intensity surface
glmnet_m_individ_row_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border") #marginal.im

#simulate comparison point patterns from a log-Gaussian Cox process
glmnet_m_individ_row_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = m.lgcp_lp$basis.fn.info$scale[1]))) #sqrt(3)*opt$minimum

#produce graphs
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
glmnet_m_individ_row_kfunc = Kfunc(glmnet_m_individ_row_K_obs, glmnet_m_individ_row_K_env)
```

```{r Data Preprocessing}
library(disdat)
library(mgcv)
library(sf)
library(spatstat)
library(fields)
library(tmap)
library(grid)
library(units)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(glmnet)
library(scampr)
library(glmmTMB)
set.seed(0)

#load data
po = disPo("NSW")
bg = disBg("NSW")
border_lonlat = disBorder("NSW")

#convert presence/background data frames to sf objects using their lon/lat coords (EPSG:4326)
po_lonlat = st_as_sf(po, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) #remove = FALSE keeps x, y
bg_lonlat = st_as_sf(bg, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

target_crs = 3577 # Australian Albers, coordinates in metres

#project border, presence, and background points from lon/lat into Albers metres
border_proj = st_transform(border_lonlat, crs = target_crs)
po_proj = st_transform(po_lonlat, crs = target_crs) 
bg_proj = st_transform(bg_lonlat, crs = target_crs)

#extract projected coordinates as a plain matrix
coords_po = st_coordinates(po_proj)
coords_bg = st_coordinates(bg_proj)

#drop geometry column --> plain data frame
po_model = st_drop_geometry(po_proj)
bg_model = st_drop_geometry(bg_proj)

#rescale projected coordinates from metres to kilometres, for numerical stability
po_model$x = coords_po[, "X"]/1000
po_model$y = coords_po[, "Y"]/1000

bg_model$x <- coords_bg[, "X"]/1000
bg_model$y <- coords_bg[, "Y"]/1000

#covariates of data
covar_names = c("cti", "disturb", "mi", "rainann", "raindq", "rugged",
                "soildepth", "soilfert", "solrad", "tempann", "tempmin", "topo", "vegsys")

#keep rows with complete covariate data
po_keep = complete.cases(po_model[, covar_names])
bg_keep = complete.cases(bg_model[, covar_names])

po_lonlat = po_lonlat[po_keep, ]
bg_lonlat = bg_lonlat[bg_keep, ]

#total study region area (km^2), used to compute quadrature weights
domain_area_km2 <- as.numeric(set_units(sum(st_area(border_proj)), km^2))

load("bg_model.RDATA")
quad_wt <- domain_area_km2 / nrow(bg_model) #each background/quadrature point represents domain_area_km2
```


```{r Build presence, quadrature data frames}
#processed dataframes
presence_df = data.frame(
  spid = po_model$spid, 
  x = po_model$x, y = po_model$y,
  po_model[, covar_names],
  presence = 1, 
  quad.size = 0) #quadrature weights not used at the point events

quad = data.frame(
  x = bg_model$x, y = bg_model$y,
  bg_model[, covar_names],
  presence = 0,
  quad.size = quad_wt) #area represented per quad point

species = unique(po_model$spid)
m = length(species) #no. of species
q <- nrow(quad) #no. of quadrature points

#replicate background points once per species for multi-species scheme)
quad <- quad[rep(seq_len(q), m), ]
quad$spid <- rep(species, each = q) #label each replicate block with its species id

#combine presence, quadrature rows into long-format dataframe
dat <- rbind(presence_df, quad)
n <- nrow(dat)

#pt/wt - standard DWPR (down-weighted Poisson regression) construction
#pt = 1 - presence rows, 0 - quadrature rows
#wt = tiny fixed weight for presence rows, area-based weight for quadrature rows
dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$pt = dat$presence
dat$wt = ifelse(dat$presence == 1, 1e-6, dat$quad.size)
```

```{r Scaling}
dat[, cont_vars] = as.data.frame(dat_scaled)
```

```{r Fitting - alternating column/row updates (single latent spatial factor)}
ridgePen=1 #penalty strength
nGlmnetIter=40 #max iterations glmnet allowed

### standardise X's up here to variance of one ###

#initialise shared latent spatial field coefficients (u), one per basis function
u = rnorm(ncol(Z_star), 0, 1)

#rename spid, attach Zu = each basis function's column scaled by u[k]
#(elementwise scaling via sweep - keeps all 50 basis functions SEPARATE, so column-update step can estimate full 50-length loading vector per species)
dat_rename = dat %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
#  mutate(Zu = sweep(Z_star, 2, u, "*"))#
#  

attach(dat_rename)
Zu = Z_star%*%u
chosen_spid = unique(spid)
n_species = length(chosen_spid)

X_full = cbind(1, tempann, rainann, rugged) #543323 x 4, fixed-effect design matrix

X_Zu = cbind(X_full[, -1], Zu)
beta_lambda = matrix(NA,  nrow = n_species, ncol = ncol(Zu) + ncol(X_full)) #fitted intercept+beta+lambda per species
new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(Z_star), ncol = 1) #k x 1

rows_by_species = split(seq_len(nrow(dat_rename)), spid)
species_idx_row = match(spid, chosen_spid) #543323 x 1

N = 40 #max no. of outer (column-update + row-update) iterations
loglik = -Inf
warm_start = vector("list", n_species)
warm_start_u = vector("list", nrow(new_u))
penalty_factor = c(rep(0, ncol(X_full) - 1), rep(1, ncol(Zu)))

time_i = system.time({for (iter in 1:N){
  # column update: for each species, fit fixed effects + basis-function loadings (lambda)

  X_Zu = cbind(X_full[, -1], Zu)

  for (j in seq_along(chosen_spid)){ #full presence dataset containing all species
    i = chosen_spid[j]
    idx = rows_by_species[[as.character(i)]]
    #design matrix - covariates + species' rows of spatial term (Zu)
#    X = cbind(dat_rename$tempann[dat_rename$spid == i]/25, dat_rename$rainann[dat_rename$spid == i]/320, dat_rename$rugged[dat_rename$spid == i]/29, dat_rename$Zu[dat_rename$spid == i, ])

    X_i = X_Zu[idx, ]
    
    #weighted Poisson ridge regression - DWPR response (pt/wt), weight = wt
#    glmnet1 = glmnet(y = dat_rename$pt[dat_rename$spid == i]/dat_rename$wt[dat_rename$spid == i], x = X, intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = dat_rename$wt[dat_rename$spid == i], alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, maxit=nGlmnetIter, standardize=FALSE) #penalty.factor = penalty_factor)

    glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(y = pt[idx]/wt[idx], x = as.matrix(X_i), family = poisson(link = 'log'), weights = wt[idx], intercept = TRUE, alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, warm = warm_start[[j]], penalty.factor = penalty_factor)#, maxit = nGlmnetIter)
    
    # store this species' intercept + beta (3 covariates) + lambda (1 loading)
    beta_lambda[j, ] = t(c(glmnet1$a0, as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))) 
#    beta_lambda[j, ] = coef(glmnet1) 
    #warm_start[[j]] = list(a0 = glmnet1$a0, beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))

  }
  
  #split fitted coefficients into fixed effects (beta) and basis-function loadings (lambda)
  beta_lambda
  beta = beta_lambda[, 1:ncol(X_full)] #54 x 4
  lambda = as.matrix(beta_lambda[, (ncol(X_full) + 1):ncol(beta_lambda)]) #54 x 1
  lambda_rep = lambda[species_idx_row, , drop = TRUE]

  offset = rowSums(X_full * beta[species_idx_row, , drop = FALSE]) #543323 x 1: matrix indexing -- pick one value per row; returns 543323 values = offset_matrix[row_idx, col_idx], e.g. offset_matrix[27, 2] to match each row's (dat_rename) true species label back to the correct column

  X_joint = Z_star * lambda_rep #543323 x 1, lambda expanded to the length of all locations
  attr(X_joint, "xm") = rep(0, ncol(X_joint))
  attr(X_joint, "xs") = rep(1, ncol(X_joint))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(new_u)){
    glmnet1 = glmnet:::glmnet.fit(x = X_joint[, i, drop = FALSE], y = pt/wt, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), weights = wt, offset = as.numeric(offset), alpha = 0, lambda = ridgePen, warm = warm_start_u[[i]]) 
    new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
    warm_start_u[[i]] = list(a0 = 0, beta = as.numeric(glmnet1$beta))
   }

  u = new_u #k x 1, updated shared spatial field coefficients
  print(u)
  
  #rebuild Zu with updated u, for next iteration's column update
#  dat_rename$Zu = sweep(Z_star, 2, u, "*") #Z_star%*%u  #543323 x k
  Zu = Z_star%*%u
  
  #convergence check - weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood kernel + Gaussian prior on u --- ##
  eta = offset + (Z_star * lambda_rep) %*% u #543323 x 1, per-row linear predictor (fixed + spatial)
  mu = exp(eta)
  pred_mglmnet_individ_row = mu

  #weighted Poisson-process log-likelihood (DWPR/Berman-Turner approximation)
  loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row = sum(pt * log(mu) - wt * mu)
  cat("iter", iter, "loglik:", loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row, "\n")
  
  #stop once relative change in log-likelihood is small
  if (is.finite(loglik) && abs(loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row - loglik)/ max(1, abs(loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row)) < 1e-6) break
  loglik = loglik_new_mglmnet_individ_row}
})

time_mglmnet_individ_row = as.numeric(time_i[3])
time_mglmnet_individ_row
```


```{r Intensity map for a chosen species}
#prediction grid coordinates + covariates
load("grid_xy.RDATA")

#fixed-effect design matrix at grid locations
X_grid = model.matrix( ~tempann + rainann + rugged, data = grid_xy) #18277 x 4

#evaluate basis functions at grid locations, using the same bfs as model fitting
Z_grid = get.bf.matrix(m.lgcp_lp, grid_xy[, c("x", "y")]) #18277 x 43
#nonzero_cols = colSums(Z_grid != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
Z_grid_star = Z_grid[, nonzero_cols, drop = FALSE] #18277 x 43

#spatial term at grid locations, scaled by the fitted shared u
#Zu_grid = sweep(Z_grid_star, 2, u, "*")
Zu_grid = Z_grid_star%*%u

target_species_id = 9
species_idx = which(chosen_spid == target_species_id)

#predicted intensity for every species at every grid cell, then select just one species' column
z_matrix = exp(X_grid%*%t(beta) + Zu_grid%*%t(lambda))
grid_xy$z = z_matrix[, species_idx]

#builds intensity map - study region border + fitted intensity surface + this species' presence points
load("m_intensity_map.RDATA")

#spatial polygons matching grid_xy locations
load("grid_cells_proj.RDATA") 
#attach predicted intensity to grid cell geometries, transform to lon/lat for plotting
grid_pred_proj = st_sf(intensity = grid_xy$z,
                       log_intensity = log(grid_xy$z),
                       geometry = grid_cells_proj)
grid_pred_lonlat = st_transform(grid_pred_proj, target = 4326)

#pull this species' own presence points, convert km back to metres, then to lon/lat for plotting
species_points = dat_rename %>% filter(spid == target_species_id, pt == 1)
species_points_metres = species_points
species_points_metres$x = species_points$x * 1000
species_points_metres$y = species_points$y * 1000

species_points_sf = st_as_sf(species_points_metres, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = target_crs)
species_points_lonlat = st_transform(species_points_sf, crs = 4326)

glmnet_m_individ_row_map = m_intensity_map(grid_pred_lonlat, species_label = 9)
print(glmnet_m_individ_row_map)
```

```{r Inhomogeneous K functions}
#diagnostic for the chosen species, target_species_id

#Calculate observed, simulated K functions

#prediction grid, drop old "z" column, then re-attach this species' own z
domain.grid = subset(grid_xy, select = -z)
#predict intensity values for this species at every grid cell
domain.grid$z = grid_xy$z

#parameter values - this species' own 43 basis-function loading
lambda_j = lambda[species_idx, ]

#variance of the shared latent spatial field coefficients u (assumed common across all 43 basis functions)
var_u = 1/ridgePen

#per-basis-function variance of this species' realised spatial contribution (u_k * lambda_jk):
#Var(u_k * lambda_jk) = lambda_jk^2 * Var(u_k), lambda_jk fixed, known
vars <- rep(var_u, m.lgcp_lp$basis.per.res)

#propagate variance through basis functions at every grid location - Var(sum_k Z_k(loc) * u_k * lambda_jk) = sum_k Z_k(loc)^2 * Var(u_k * lambda_jk)
var_smooth_grid <- drop((Z_grid_star * lambda_j)^2 %*% vars)

#average propagated variance
var_smooth = mean(var_smooth_grid)
#var_smooth = var(drop(Z_grid_star%*%u)) #Z_grid_star

#this species' fixed-effect-only linear predictor - used as mean
domain.grid$mean = drop(X_grid%*%beta[species_idx, ])

#build observation window in same centred/rescaled km coordinate system used throughout
border_km = st_union(st_geometry(border_proj))/1000
st_crs(border_km) = NA
win = as.owin(st_sf(geometry = border_km))

#convert fixed-effect surface and full fitted intensity surface into spatstat pixel images
fixed.im = as.im(domain.grid[, c("x", "y", "mean")], W = win)
#converted predicted intensity value into spatstat pixel images
pred.im = as.im(domain.grid[,c("x","y","z")], W = win)

#simulate the envelopes/bounds

#rename presence_df's spid to match dat_rename's convention, then subset to just this species' own presence locations
pres_df_rename = presence_df %>% 
  mutate(spid = as.numeric(str_extract(spid, "\\d+")))
sp_presence_df = pres_df_rename[pres_df_rename$spid == target_species_id, ]
# build species' point pattern within study window
po_sp_ppp = ppp(x = sp_presence_df$x,
                y = sp_presence_df$y,
                window = win)

#load("opt.RDATA")

#observed inhomogeneous K-function for this species, using its fitted intensity surface
glmnet_m_individ_row_K_obs <- Kinhom(po_sp_ppp, lambda = pred.im, correction = "border") #marginal.im

#simulate comparison point patterns from a log-Gaussian Cox process
glmnet_m_individ_row_K_env <- envelope(po_sp_ppp, fun = Kinhom, simulate = expression(rLGCP(model = "matern", mu = fixed.im, var = var_smooth, nu = 3/2, scale = m.lgcp_lp$basis.fn.info$scale[1]))) #sqrt(3)*opt$minimum

#produce graphs
load("Kfunc.RDATA")
glmnet_m_individ_row_kfunc = Kfunc(glmnet_m_individ_row_K_obs, glmnet_m_individ_row_K_env)
```
